exposure: Mesenchymal stem cell-derived conditioned media (MSCCM) from adipose tissue (AT-MSCCM)
Mesenchymal stem cell-derived conditioned media (MSCCM) from amniotic membrane (AM-MSCCM)
Priming of MSC with pro-inflammatory cytokine (IFN-gamma)
cohort: The study utilized SH-SY5Y human neuroblastoma cells.
finding: AT-MSCCM showed higher proliferative capacity and impact on neurite outgrowth, while AM-MSCCM exhibited more pronounced immunomodulatory activity, migration, and re-growth of SH-SY5Y cells, with IFN-gamma priming further altering proteomic profiles and effects on proliferation and neurite outgrowth.
